description: Traces what one participant experiences in this webinar, in order and WITHOUT sending anything: which confirmation and reminder emails go out at which moment (and which are switched off), when the room opens, when the offer appears, and when the replay shows. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it when the host asks what the participants get and when, whether a reminder is missing, or why someone would see the offer too early. It is the cheapest way to check the timing before a launch. For how many people really came use wi_get_webinar_attendance_stats, for what the campaign earned wi_get_webinar_revenue_woocommerce. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.
